# Cohesion walk walk-12: 14 item-on-target pairs, each on its own spot, real input only.
# Generated by tools/cohesion/gen_walk.py from tools/cohesion/pairs.tsv and setup.json; do not edit by hand.
# Run: bash tools/smoke.sh tools/cohesion/walk-12.txt   then: python tools/cohesion/collect.py run-smoke/smoke-out OUTDIR
@world flat
@gamemode survival
@difficulty easy
@observe 30
wait 40
/gamerule doMobSpawning false
/gamerule doDaylightCycle false
/gamerule doWeatherCycle false
/gamerule doImmediateRespawn true
/gamerule keepInventory true
/gamerule showDeathMessages false
/gamerule spawnRadius 0
/gamerule announceAdvancements false
/time set 6000
/weather clear
/setworldspawn 0 -60 -130
/forceload add -96 -112 96 112
wait 40
/kill @e[type=!minecraft:player]
wait 5
report WALK walk-12 14 pairs

# ---- N143: (empty) | HOSTED villager (sync 80) | the air (an Ability press) | a pillager 12 off
report PAIR N143 begin spot -72 -96 expect HOSTED aim miss | (empty) | HOSTED villager (sync 80) | the air (an Ability press) | a pillager 12 off
/say PAIR N143
/kill @e[type=minecraft:slime]
/tp @s -71.5 -60 -95.5 0 0
/effect give @s minecraft:resistance 999 4 true
/effect give @s minecraft:saturation 999 0 true
wait 5
/clear @s
wait 5
hostify minecraft:villager -72 -60 -96
wait 5
/data merge entity @e[type=minecraft:villager,x=-71.5,y=-60,z=-95.5,distance=..1.5,limit=1] {NoAI:1b}
/tp @s -68.5 -60 -95.5 0 0
jar
wait 5
mount
wait 10
sync 80
report waiting out the first-ride handshake
wait 140
/summon minecraft:pillager -59.5 -60 -91.5 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b}
wait 5
look 0 -60
wait 10
/item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with minecraft:air
/item replace entity @s weapon.offhand with minecraft:air
wait 10
riding PRE-N143
inspect me
inspect aim
report PAIR N143 act key ability
key ability
wait 12
shot cw-N143
wait 17
inspect me
report PAIR N143 end
/kill @s
wait 15
/kill @e[type=!minecraft:player,x=-78,y=-62,z=-102,dx=18,dy=14,dz=18]
/fill -78 -60 -102 -60 -48 -84 minecraft:air
/fill -78 -61 -102 -60 -61 -84 minecraft:grass_block
wait 3
/kill @e[type=minecraft:item,x=-78,y=-62,z=-102,dx=18,dy=14,dz=18]
/clear @s
riding RESET-N143
